tests.name: Every shrine, NPC, chest and final altar reachable on foot
Movement respects map boundaries and solid objects
Shooting hits, kills and awards XP
Dash grants immunity and cannot ignore cooldown
All three heroes: Q, E and R function and spend resources
Potions, shops and level rewards have bounded costs
Three seals and final encounter enforce progression
Save and restore preserve character, progress and combat health
Death and respawn retain progress, charge correct gold penalty
Boss projectile death does not break the update loop
All local HTML dependencies exist; no remote runtime dependencies
Ultimate attacks never refill their own charge; dropped loot survives saves
